intent: Lands a reviewed, QA'd change: enforces the review/QA/supply-chain gates, runs the full check suite, treats push/PR/deploy as hard gates, records a ship artifact, and never bypasses a check.

dimensions.name: enforces-upstream-gates
dimensions.criterion: Won't land past unresolved review security findings, QA blocking bugs, or a supply-chain gate.

dimensions.name: hard-gates-irreversible
dimensions.criterion: Push, open-PR, and deploy are hard gates — stop and ask, never batched through --yes.

dimensions.name: full-check-suite
dimensions.criterion: Runs the stack's test/lint/typecheck/build from commands.*; any failure halts.

dimensions.name: records-artifact
dimensions.criterion: Writes the ship report as run artifact 06-ship.md and releases the run lock.

dimensions.name: no-bypass
dimensions.criterion: Never --no-verify, never force-push a shared branch; budget warns, never blocks.
